caption:
One wild paint throw and the blank canvas becomes a mountain range.
Seedance 2.0 animated the whole studio, sleepy cat included.
prompt:
use seedance 2.5 for this

VIDEO PROMPT — 15 seconds, 16:9 landscape. Stylized 3D animated feature-film look: soft rounded characters, rich subsurface skin, glossy wet paint, warm cozy studio light from bare hanging bulbs with golden-orange glow against cool grey concrete walls, gentle film depth of field. Camera feel: playful and cinematic, clean moves, one fast whip pan. Pacing: comic build-up, a big paint explosion, a slow magical transformation, a deadpan cat beat, then a proud button ending. No on-screen text, no logos, no subtitles.

CHARACTERS:
- THE PAINTER: Black woman in her early 30s, warm deep-brown skin, curvy build, big voluminous shoulder-length dark-brown curly afro, round thin-framed glasses, wide bright smile, small hoop earrings. White long-sleeve button-up shirt with sleeves rolled to the elbows, untucked, splattered with orange, pink and blue paint; light-blue jeans rolled at the ankles; white sneakers. Signature: the curly afro and round glasses in every shot.
- THE CAT: chubby orange tabby cat with darker orange stripes, white muzzle and chest, amber eyes, curled up in a loaf on the lid of a battered grey metal paint can splattered with paint.

LOCATION: a cluttered artist's studio: grey concrete walls, a wooden easel holding a large square white canvas, blank canvases leaning against the walls, stacks of old books on the floor, paint jars and brushes, a wooden floor smeared with colorful paint drips, two bare light bulbs hanging on cords glowing warm orange.

SHOT 1 (00:00.0-00:01.0) — The fling. Wide shot from the front-right, eye level, locked-off: the painter stands center-right with feet apart, laughing, arms flung wide, flicking a wide brush at the canvas on the easel at frame left; pink and blue splashes already on the white canvas. The cat sleeps curled on the paint can at bottom right. Bare bulb glowing top center.
SHOT 2 (00:01.0-00:02.4) — Brush close-up. Tight side close-up of her two brown hands gripping a wide flat brush loaded with bright turquoise-blue paint, slapping and dragging it across the canvas covered in hot-pink and turquoise splatter; thick paint drips run down the canvas. Shallow depth of field, background a soft blur. Slow push-in.
SHOT 3 (00:02.4-00:04.8) — The explosion. Low-angle wide shot from behind her right shoulder, the canvas on the easel at center-left: she winds back, then lunges one big step forward and hurls paint; neon rainbow paint (pink, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple) EXPLODES across the canvas in a radial starburst, blobs of paint flying through the air and splattering the walls and floor. She then stands back, seen from behind, hands at her sides, looking at it; the cat still asleep on the paint can at bottom right. MUST SHOW: the radial rainbow paint burst covering the whole canvas.
SHOT 4 (00:04.8-00:11.0) — The transformation. Front-on, eye level, slow steady push-in on the canvas on the easel; the concrete wall behind is covered in big pink, purple, yellow and green paint splatters, and the easel ledge drips with colorful paint. The canvas is a marbled psychedelic swirl of pink, teal, yellow and green; the paint starts to swirl and a realistic mountain landscape opens up in the center like a whirlpool, spreading outward as the rainbow swirls curl away to the edges and vanish. By 00:07.0 the whole canvas is a detailed painted mountain landscape: one tall jagged snow-capped peak in the center, smaller blue peaks on both sides, bright blue sky with puffy white clouds, green valleys, dark pine trees and grey rock outcrops in the foreground. The camera keeps creeping closer until the painting fills almost the whole frame, splattered wall only at the left and right edges. MUST SHOW: the swirling rainbow paint morphing into the snow-capped mountain landscape.
SHOT 5 (00:11.0-00:11.5) — Whip pan. Fast whip pan to the left, the studio smeared into motion blur of warm browns and pink streaks.
SHOT 6 (00:11.5-00:13.0) — Unimpressed cat. Close-up at eye level, locked-off, on the orange tabby cat loafed on the lid of the paint can, blurry studio behind: it stares straight into the camera with half-closed, unimpressed amber eyes, slowly blinks its eyes shut, then lets out a huge wide yawn showing its pink tongue and small teeth. MUST SHOW: the cat's big yawn.
SHOT 7 (00:13.0-00:15.1) — The shrug. Medium shot, eye level: the finished mountain painting on the easel at frame left, the painter standing at frame right with a bare bulb glowing behind her; she turns from the painting to face the camera with a modest proud smile and lifts her right hand palm-up in a casual "no big deal" shrug, then holds the pose completely still to the end, like a freeze frame.

SOUND: light playful upbeat instrumental beat with plucky strings throughout. SHOT 1: wet paint flicks and splats. SHOT 2: a sharp exhale, thick squelching brush strokes. SHOT 3: a big wet whoosh and a burst of splatters hitting canvas, walls and floor. SHOT 4: a soft shimmering magical hum that builds as the paint swirls, rising into a gentle swell when the mountain appears. SHOT 5: a quick whoosh. SHOT 6: the music drops out, a small squeaky cat yawn. SHOT 7: the music returns with a short bright final note. No dialogue.
prompt_short: 3D animated film look, cozy studio: a curly-haired painter in round glasses hurls neon paint at a canvas, the rainbow swirl morphs into a snow-capped mountain painting, her orange cat yawns, she shrugs proudly. Playful, warm light.
